footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $15K income tax benefit. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $210M from $209M.
The net loss narrowed to $155M, or −$79.02 per share, from $208M. Operating cash flow was −$169M and free cash flow −$169M, versus −$157M.
sources: Spyre Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We will not be able to continue as a going concern if we are unable to raise additional capital when needed…
